posts.name: Natediggadoggity
posts.cooked: What was Challenge Ambuscade before, and what is it now? I’m curious about why it changes.
posts.raw: What was Challenge Ambuscade before, and what is it now? I'm curious about why it changes.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked:
It used to be that his Traps were face up in the deck to start.  When revealed they did their thing, got shuffled into the deck face up again, and then played the top card of the deck.   It got changed to this:

  • At the start of the game, turn all Trap cards in Ambuscade’s deck face up. 
  • Whenever a Trap card would be discarded, first the top card of the villain deck is played, then the Trap card is discarded. 
  • Whenever the villain trash is shuffled into the villain deck, all Trap cards are turned face up.

 

The reason was that if you prevented Ambuscade from dealing damage you could end up in an almost never ending loop of Traps being played.

posts.name: Natediggadoggity
posts.cooked:
I see, I tried it on the app today, and it’s still a little too strong, because one “armed and dangerous” can start a chain reaction that reveals several traps in a row before getting a device, and stacks several extra card plays on top of each other.

I don’t think face up traps should stack a card play, and then he might finally have an appropriate power curve.

I don’t mind him chaining card plays, that’s his mechanic, and if he’s lucky enough to play a quick stim patch into a run and gun several times in a row, that’s fine. He just got lucky.

It’s when I know there’s an additional +3 card plays to wade through, which can each trigger their own run of additional chained plays together that it just gets ridiculous and un-fun.
